tool_rules.open_browser: Use once at the beginning for this site's base URL or a known search URL.
tool_rules.click_marker: Use only visible OCR/SoM marker IDs. For job cards, include target_label with the visible job title.
tool_rules.type_in_marker: Use for visible search inputs only.
tool_rules.press_key: Use enter for search submission after typing when safe.
tool_rules.scroll: Use page scroll for the document, or provide marker_id when an internal panel or embedded detail area has its own scroll.
tool_rules.go_back: Use when detail navigation occurred in the current tab; do not click browser toolbar back markers.
tool_rules.close_current_tab: Use when a detail page opened in a separate browser tab and go_back cannot return to results.
tool_rules.switch_tab: Use only when an adjacent browser tab must be inspected without closing the current tab.
tool_rules.update_extracted_info: Use only after reading job-specific facts from the current detail page.
tool_rules.finish_task: Use after requested site scope is complete.
tool_rules.close_browser: Cleanup only; do not use during active collection.
